title: Fairness-Aware Network Embeddings: Methods, Applications, and Challenges
abstract: arXiv:2608.19381v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Network embedding methods learn low-dimensional representations of graph-structured data to support downstream tasks such as node classification, link prediction, and influence maximization. However, real-world networks often reflect structural inequalities arising from demographic imbalances, homophily, and other societal biases, which fairness-agnostic embedding methods can encode and amplify. To address this issue, numerous fairness-aware network embedding methods have been proposed to mitigate bias while preserving embedding utility. This survey presents a comprehensive overview of fairness-aware network embeddings for complex networks. We propose a taxonomy that categorizes existing methods along three main complementary dimensions: underlying embedding approach (spectral, random walk, graph neural network, Bayesian, and method-agnostic), fairness intervention strategy (pre-processing, in-processing, and post-processing), and fair

translated_title: 公平感知的网络嵌入：方法、应用与挑战
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19381v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：网络嵌入方法学习图结构数据的低维表示，以支持节点分类、链接预测和影响力最大化等下游任务。然而，现实世界的网络往往反映了由人口统计不平衡、同质性和其他社会偏见引起的结构性不平等，而忽视公平性的嵌入方法可能会编码并放大这些不平等。为解决这一问题，已提出了众多公平感知的网络嵌入方法，旨在减轻偏见的同时保持嵌入效用。本综述全面概述了复杂网络的公平感知网络嵌入。我们提出了一种分类法，沿三个主要互补维度对现有方法进行分类：底层嵌入方法（谱方法、随机游走、图神经网络、贝叶斯和方法无关）、公平干预策略（预处理、处理中和后处理）以及公平性度量。
tldr: 本文综述了公平感知网络嵌入方法，提出了一种三维分类法（嵌入方法、干预策略和公平度量），系统梳理了现有技术以在保持嵌入效用的同时减轻网络数据中的社会偏见。
en_tdlr: This survey reviews fairness-aware network embedding methods, proposing a three-dimensional taxonomy (embedding approach, intervention strategy, and fairness metric) to systematically organize techniques that mitigate societal biases in graph data while preserving embedding utility.
